::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 1,458,154 people lived in County Dublin, up 8.2% on 2016. It had the largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 3.9 times its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Dublin was €2,159, the highest of the 26 counties.
:::
